# Radoslav Radev Requires A Minimum Of 10 Seconds Tuck Planche With Good Form Before Advanced Planche

Radoslav Radev says that before you go from tuck planche to advanced planche you need a minimum of 10 seconds with good form. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46]

## Details

- Before you go from tuck planche to advanced planche, he says to make sure you have minimum 10 seconds with good form and good technique. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46]
- He also says not to wait too much: if you have 10 seconds you are ready, but not if you have two seconds. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:56]
- For straddle front lever to full front lever he says to make sure you have at least 10 seconds clean straddle front lever. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:06]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46 (Radoslav Radev): "let's say you are on tuck planche before you go to advanced planche make sure that you have minimum 10 seconds with good form good technique and then you're ready to go"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:56 (Radoslav Radev): "don't wait too much because you will waste also a lot of time so if you have 10 seconds you're ready but not if you have two seconds"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:06 (Radoslav Radev): "if you want to go from straddle front lever to full front lever, make sure that you have at least 10 seconds clean straddle front lever"
